topics.heading: What I write about
topics.intro: Posts here are practical rather than theoretical: problems hit on real client projects, the options weighed, what got chosen, and what it cost. Expect code, numbers, and the occasional retraction when a decision aged badly. Published when there is something worth writing down, not on a schedule.

react.title: React & Next.js in production
react.description: App Router patterns, server and client component boundaries, data fetching, caching and revalidation, and the trade-offs behind rendering strategies on real products.

typescript.title: TypeScript at scale
typescript.description: Typing API layers and shared contracts, keeping generics readable, and the conventions that keep a growing codebase reviewable instead of clever.

architecture.title: Frontend architecture
architecture.description: Folder conventions, state management with Redux Toolkit and React Query, design systems in Storybook, and where abstractions actually pay for themselves.

performance.title: Performance & Core Web Vitals
performance.description: Bundle budgets, image and font strategy, animation without jank, WebGL scenes that clean up after themselves, and measuring LCP, INP, and CLS on real devices.

testing.title: Testing & delivery
testing.description: Jest and Testing Library where they earn their keep, end-to-end coverage of critical flows, Docker builds, and CI pipelines that stay fast enough to trust.

team.title: Team & engineering practice
team.description: Lessons from leading frontend teams — code review that catches real problems, estimation that survives contact with a deadline, and shipping without burning the team.
